stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If you chose to push it, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS WALKER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit and, if you chose to push it, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons and they have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS WALKER unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
stratagems.tg: That ORKS WALKER unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit targets an Infantry unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon has the [BLAST] ability.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units) that is within range of the loot objective.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit falls back.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is not within range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Flash Gitz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] ability.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: Two BOYZ units from your army that are within 6" of each other.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6" of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purpose of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One BOYZ unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding CHARACTER models).

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 9", a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Dakkastorm Stratagem in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9", they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Blitza Fire Stratagem in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.tg: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: That SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLEWAGON unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That BATTLEWAGON unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's ranged attacks (excluding attacks made by weapons selected with Firing Deck) have [RAPID FIRE X], where X is that attack's Attacks characteristic.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase, when a friendly WAGON unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That WAGON unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1].

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.tg: That WAGON unit.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability and, if your unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.tg: That Speed Freeks or Trukk unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in a Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back or Advanced (unless it used its turbo this turn).

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Torrent weapons) have the [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] abilities.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.fx: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: That KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.fx: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS, MONSTER and VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.

stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ORKS VEHICLE unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
stratagems.tg: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.

stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One MOB unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
stratagems.fx: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ORKS INFANTRY unit within 6" of that Mob unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Orks unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
